title: Quarterly Symphony: Private / On‑Prem OKR Translation & Cross‑Team Activation Plan
creator: Aisha Patel
description: High-level plan for translating enterprise OKRs for Private / VPC / On‑prem features into a coordinated quarterly execution plan. Focus is on aligning engineering, infra, product, design, and GTM runways to deliver safe tenant activation windows, observability coverage, and rollforward gates for Q2 launches.
goal_statement: Deliver a repeatable, auditable quarterly playbook that maps enterprise OKRs to prioritized workstreams, release gates, and stakeholder handoffs so three pilot customers can be onboarded to Private instances with SLA parity and verified telemetry by the end of the quarter.
okrs: OKR 1: Enable 3 enterprise Private activations with zero critical outages (SLO 99.9%)
OKR 2: Reduce time-to-onboard (first successful inference) for Private by 40% vs last quarter
OKR 3: Formalize cost/latency guardrails and publish per-tenant telemetry dashboards used in go/no-go decisions
milestones: M1 (2026-04-07): OKR-to-initiative mapping complete + prioritized backlog (stakeholder sign-off)
M2 (2026-04-28): Release readiness checklist & safe-launch canary plan documented
M3 (2026-05-20): Observability gates (console dashboards + tracing hooks) instrumented on private control plane
M4 (2026-06-10): Pilot tenant 1 activation window + post-launch review
M5 (2026-06-24): Pilot tenant 2 & 3 activation waves and consolidation report
acceptance_criteria: Backlog items mapped to OKRs with clear owner and estimated effort
Release readiness checklist includes rollback and cutover runbooks, validated in a dry-run
Telemetry: per-tenant latency/cost dashboard visible in Console with 1min granularity
Onboarding runbook reduces manual steps to <= 6 (previous baseline 10)
Canary policy defined: 5% traffic, 24h observation window, automated fallback path
dependencies: ENG-72184 (runtime: kernel selection fixes for onprem NVLink topologies)
ENG-73402 (private control plane: RBAC + audit log schema stabilized)
PM-71258 (customer onboarding templates and legal ops alignment)
Security-Review: KMS integration sign-off (security ticket pending)
risks: Telemetry lag on private control plane could delay go/no-go decisions — mitigation: synthetic probes + increased retention for pilot tenants
Third‑party KMS certification timeline slip could block pilot activation — mitigation: fallbacks to ephemeral keys for non-regulated tenants
Unexpected kernel regressions for quantized variants under load — mitigation: reserve canary capacity and rollback policy
Customer network constraints (on‑prem firewalls) may require extra runbook steps — mitigation: preflight checklist and remote assist slot scheduling
rollout_strategy: Wave 0: dry‑run with internal infra tenants (validate runbooks and telemetry)
Wave 1: Pilot tenant A (non-critical workloads) — 1 week canary then full cutover
Wave 2: Pilot tenants B & C staggered with 72h spacing; each with independent rollback gates
Post-activation: 7‑day monitoring window and a joint postmortem; acceptance determined by OKR metrics
success_metrics: Number of pilot activations completed: target >=3
Onboarding time: median time-to-first-inference reduced by 40%
SLO Compliance: 99.9% availability during pilot windows
Operational overhead: manual handoff steps reduced to <=6
Telemetry coverage: 100% of activation runbooks include required dashboards and traces
